name: Director Mode Lite
headline: Director Mode Lite - Automate Workflows
short_description: Director Mode Lite enables operations teams to automate workflows using Claude Code. It provides a free toolkit with Auto-Loop, 13 commands, 3 agents, and 4 skills. Ideal for non-programmers, it streamlines task automation and integrates with Claude Code plugins.
author: claude-world

sections.overview:
Director Mode Lite is a free automation toolkit that transforms how you use Claude Code by letting you direct AI execution instead of writing code manually. It provides Auto-Loop, a TDD-driven automation system that tracks acceptance criteria and guides the red-green-refactor cycle, plus Self-Evolving Loop for dynamic strategy improvement across multiple iterations. The toolkit includes 13 commands, 3 agents (code-reviewer, test-runner integration), and multi-agent collaboration features, making it ideal for operations teams and non-programmers who need to automate complex workflows without coding knowledge. Compatible with Claude Opus 4.6 and supporting 1M context windows, it integrates directly into Claude Code with checkpoint recovery and parallel agent execution.
Automating TDD workflows with acceptance criteria tracking and checkpoint recovery
Running parallel multi-agent tasks for code review and testing simultaneously
Building REST APIs and feature implementations with self-evolving execution strategies
Operations teams automating task workflows without writing code manually
